Regulation: B.C. Reg. 109/2026
Made under: School Act
Published in: No. 12 – B.C. Regs. 99 to 109, June 30, 2026
Deposit date: June 29, 2026

B.C. Reg. 109/2026, deposited June 29, 2026, under theSCHOOL ACT[section 168.02]. Ministerial Order M262/2026, dated June 26, 2026. I, Lisa Beare, Minister of Education and Child Care, order that, effective July 1, 2026, the School Calendar Regulation, B.C. Reg. 314/2012, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — L. BEARE,Minister of Education and Child Care. 1	Section 6 (6) of the School Calendar Regulation, B.C. Reg. 314/2012, is amended by striking out "2025/2026 school year" and substituting "2026/2027 school year". (a)	by striking out "In each of the 2024/2025 and 2025/2026 school years," and substituting "In the 2026/2027 school year,", and (b)	by repealing paragraph (b) and substituting the following: (b)	integrating into learning environments Indigenous world views and perspectives, in particular those of the first nations, the treaty first nations or the Nisg̱a’a Nation in whose traditional territory the board operates. minutes_briefs.title: BC School Calendar Regulation updated for 2026/2027 Indigenous learning focus
minutes_briefs.summary: The BC government has updated the School Calendar Regulation to apply to the 2026/2027 school year. This change requires school boards to integrate Indigenous world views and perspectives into learning environments, specifically those of the First Nations, treaty First Nations, or Nisga'a Nation in whose traditional territory the board operates. The update takes effect July 1, 2026.
minutes_briefs.action_required: If you operate a school or provide educational services in BC, review your curriculum to ensure it includes Indigenous perspectives as required by the updated regulation.

key_dates.label: Updated School Calendar Regulation takes effect (BC)
